title: a person who ... a thing that/which ... (relative clauses 1)
summary: Определительные придаточные: **who** (для людей), **that / which** (для вещей) — они уточняют, о каком человеке или предмете идёт речь.
ru:
## Что такое relative clause
Это часть предложения, которая объясняет, **какой** человек или предмет имеется в виду. По-русски это «который», «который ...».
> The man **who lives next door** is a doctor. — Мужчина, который живёт по соседству, врач.
> I like the bag **that you bought**. — Мне нравится сумка, которую ты купила.

## who — для людей
**Who** заменяет человека и стоит сразу после существительного.
> The woman **who works here** is my aunt. — Женщина, которая здесь работает, моя тётя.
> A teacher is a person **who teaches** students. — Учитель — это человек, который учит учеников.
> Do you know anyone **who speaks** French? — Ты знаешь кого-нибудь, кто говорит по-французски?
Можно и **that** вместо who (в разговоре): *the man **that** lives next door*.

## that / which — для вещей
**That** или **which** — для предметов и животных.
> A dictionary is a book **that / which** explains words. — Словарь — это книга, которая объясняет слова.
> Where is the cake **that / which** was on the table? — Где торт, который лежал на столе?

## who / that / which вместо подлежащего
Слово после существительного **заменяет подлежащее** придаточной части, поэтому второе подлежащее не нужно.
> ~~The man who he lives next door~~ → The man **who lives** next door.
> ~~The bag that it is on the table~~ → The bag **that is** on the table.

## Глагол согласуется с существительным
> The man **who lives** next door. (he → -s)
> The people **who live** next door. (they → без -s)

## Что не нужно путать
- **who** — только люди; ~~the book who~~ неверно.
- **what** — это не «который»: ~~the thing what~~ → the thing **that**.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She is the girl which lives here.~~ → She is the girl **who** lives here.
- ~~The book what I read.~~ → The book **that / which** I read.
- ~~The man who he called me.~~ → The man **who** called me.
- ~~A car which it has no driver.~~ → A car **which has** no driver.
en:
## What is a relative clause?
It tells us **which** person or thing we mean.
> The man **who lives next door** is a doctor.
> I like the bag **that you bought**.

## who — for people
**Who** replaces the person and comes right after the noun.
> The woman **who works here** is my aunt.
> A teacher is a person **who teaches** students.
> Do you know anyone **who speaks** French?
In speaking you can say **that** too: *the man **that** lives next door*.

## that / which — for things
> A dictionary is a book **that / which** explains words.
> Where is the cake **that / which** was on the table?

## who / that / which are the subject
The word replaces the subject, so we don't repeat it.
> ~~The man who he lives next door~~ → The man **who lives** next door.
> ~~The bag that it is on the table~~ → The bag **that is** on the table.

## Verb agreement
> The man **who lives** next door.
> The people **who live** next door.

## Don't confuse
- **who** is only for people.
- Don't say ~~the thing what~~: say **the thing that**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She is the girl which lives here.~~ → She is the girl **who** lives here.
- ~~The book what I read.~~ → The book **that / which** I read.
- ~~The man who he called me.~~ → The man **who** called me.
structure:
## Схема
| О ком / о чём | Слово | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| человек | **who** (или that) | The girl who sits next to me |
| вещь, животное | **that / which** | The book that is on the table |

## Формула
> Существительное + **who / that / which** + глагол + (остальное)
> I know a man **who speaks** five languages.
> This is the house **that was** built in 1900.

## Глагол в придаточной
| Существительное | Глагол |
|---|---|
| a man who | **lives** (3 л. ед.ч.) |
| people who | **live** |
| a thing that | **is / makes** |
| things that | **are / make** |

## Запомните
- Второго подлежащего (he, she, it, they) в придаточной **нет**.
- Для людей — **who**; для вещей — **that / which**.
- В вопросе: *Which is the book that **belongs** to you?*

items.text: The man {{who|that}} lives next door is a dentist.
I've got a friend {{who|that}} speaks four languages.
Where is the book {{that|which}} was on the table?
A hairdresser is a person {{who|that}} cuts hair.
We saw a dog {{that|which}} could swim.
Do you know the girl {{who|that}} is talking to Ben?
A key is a thing {{that|which}} opens a door.

exercises.title: Закончите определение
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол в нужной форме (Present simple): **teach, sell, make, fly, work, take**.

items.text: A teacher is a person who {{teaches}} students.
A baker is a person who {{makes|bakes}} bread.
A pilot is a person who {{flies}} planes.
A shop assistant is someone who {{sells}} things.
Doctors are people who {{work}} in hospitals.

items.q: A thief is a person ___ steals things.
This is the bus ___ goes to the airport.
The people ___ live upstairs are very noisy.
She works for a company ___ makes shoes.
I know a man ___ can fix cars.
Look at the cat ___ is sitting on the roof.
The woman ___ lives next door has three dogs.
Как сказать «Человек, который звонил, мой брат»?
options: The man who he called is my brother.
The man who called is my brother.
The man which called is my brother.
items.why: **who called** — без he; для человека — who.

items.q: Как сказать «Книга, которая лежит на столе, моя»?
options: The book that is on the table is mine.
The book who is on the table is mine.
The book that it is on the table is mine.

items.q: Как сказать «Это девочка, которая живёт рядом»?
options: She is the girl what lives next door.
She is the girl who lives next door.
She is the girl which lives next door.

items.q: Как сказать «Я знаю людей, которые говорят по-китайски»?
options: I know people who speak Chinese.
I know people who speaks Chinese.
I know people who they speak Chinese.
The dog he barks is mine.
The dog that barks is mine.
The dog what barks is mine.
items.why: Для животных — **that / which** (**who** — только о людях); he не повторяем.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения с **who / that / which**.
exercises.example: I know a woman. She speaks Chinese. → **I know a woman who speaks Chinese.**
